profile: Steven Madden designs, sources, and markets branded and private-label footwear, handbags, apparel, and accessories. Its wholesale customers include department stores, mass merchants, off-price retailers, online retailers, specialty retailers, independent stores, and clubs. It also sells products directly through company-operated retail and outlet stores, international concessions, and e-commerce platforms under brands including Steve Madden, Kurt Geiger, and Dolce Vita.
